sn35.62:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the Dhamma for the exhaustion of all clinging.
sn35.62:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, is the Dhamma for the exhaustion of all clinging?
sn35.62:2.1: What do you think, bhikkhus, is the eye permanent or impermanent?” … (To be completed as in §32) …
sn35.62:20.8: “This, bhikkhus, is the Dhamma for the exhaustion of all clinging.” II. MIGAJĀLA
